name: DashLinx – Admin Dashboard Links Widget
author: Pine Tree Host

sections.description:
DashLinx adds a simple, unobtrusive widget to the WordPress admin dashboard that allows administrators to store up to five frequently used links for quick access.

Links can be added by:
* Selecting existing Pages, Posts, or any public post type via autocomplete
* Pasting a full URL (external or internal)

When a raw URL is added, DashLinx attempts to retrieve the page title automatically.

Key Features

  • Admin dashboard widget
  • Supports Pages, Posts, and all public post types
  • External URLs supported
  • Automatic title detection for pasted URLs
  • Links can be deleted (editing is intentionally disabled)
  • Admin links open in the same tab
  • Frontend and external links open in a new tab
  • Accessible and WordPress-native UI (Dashicons, jQuery UI)

DashLinx is designed to be fast, minimal, and dependency-free, using only tools already bundled with WordPress core.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dashlinx folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Visit the WordPress Dashboard to access the DashLinx widget.

No configuration is required.
sections.faq:
Who can see and use the widget?

The widget is available to users who have access to the WordPress admin dashboard.

Where are the links stored?

Links are stored in the WordPress database and apply site-wide.

Can I edit a saved link?

No. Links can only be added or deleted. This is a deliberate design decision to keep the interface simple and predictable.

Why is there a five-link limit?

The limit keeps the widget compact and prevents dashboard clutter.

Does this plugin load assets on the frontend?

No. All scripts and styles are loaded only on the WordPress admin dashboard.

Does this plugin come with any warranty or support?

No it does not come with any warranty/guarantee expressed or implied. We cannot offer support for this free plugin. It is light-weight, but as with any free plugin, always test on your site or in a sandbox test environment first.
